会话状态 | huìhuà zhuàngtài | Session state

cues.text: Session state is the context of an ongoing interaction. In this example, it includes the episode identity, current owner, command identity, and waiting queue. A useful saved state would preserve those commitments, not just the instruction to land. Notice how the next drone waits on the right until completion is verified. We are inspecting recorded state here, not claiming to have tested session restoration.

团队记忆 | tuánduì jìyì | Team memory

cues.text: Team memory lets agents share useful knowledge. All sixteen drones can know the pad locations and landing procedure, but that does not decide who may land next. Our shared reservation ledger adds that operational authority. The close-ups show the consequence; the overview keeps the whole team in view. This is an illustration of the distinction, not a test of a commercial team-memory product.

记忆片段 | jìyì piànduàn | Memory fragments

cues.text: Memory fragments are pieces of stored information that can be recalled later. We now replay a different episode. A pad-clear snapshot from time zero arrives again at four point five seconds. It describes an earlier world, not permission to act now. Both policies reject older observations, so they agree here. The delayed snapshot illustrates a fragment's temporal limits; this is not an experiment with language-model retrieval.

观测时效 | guāncè shíxiào | Observation freshness

cues.text: Observation freshness asks how old the evidence is. In this new episode, telemetry stops after one second. Queue-awareness preserves the existing commitment but cannot verify completion remotely, so twelve drones remain waiting. The timeout case has already issued conflicting clearances. Watch the different landing paths. Holding has a cost: this model has no battery limit, so indefinite hovering is not a practical recovery strategy.

长期记忆 | chángqī jìyì | Long-term memory

cues.text: Long-term memory retains information across sessions. Reusable maps and procedures are examples of what might be retained; our static configuration illustrates that role, not a learned memory system. We finish with timely messages, where both fleets succeed. The lesson is the vocabulary: retained knowledge, session context, shared information, and fresh active state do different jobs. Queue-aware autonomy gives these distinctions visible physical consequences, without claiming hardware validation.
